editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Grand Capital is an offshore broker scoring 5.4/10 from NAFT in 2026. SVG registered — no meaningful regulation. Operating since 2006. $10 deposit, ECN Prime available, PAMM accounts for managed investing. No investor protection. Community complaints about withdrawal delays. Best only for traders in regions with no access to regulated alternatives.
